name: Should I remove the pool before landscaping the yard?

mainEntity.name: If I want a new yard design, should pool demolition happen before planting, irrigation, or hardscape work?
mainEntity.text: If I want a new yard design, should pool demolition happen before planting, irrigation, or hardscape work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, pool demolition should usually come before most landscaping work. The site needs to be demolished, backfilled, compacted, and graded before planting, irrigation, pavers, decking, or lawn installation begin. If landscaping is installed too early, later settling can damage the new work and lead to expensive repairs. The demolition phase also gives the design team a clearer view of the available space and drainage needs. Homeowners planning a full backyard transformation should coordinate the demolition schedule with the landscape contractor so the new design matches the finished grade. If hardscape or irrigation is part of the next phase, it is smart to confirm that the ground will be stable enough before those trades start.
